proposal.scope: Accelerate only veto candidate reachability geometry; retain H2bd fast lexical geometry and every H2be16/48 policy rule. Exact candidate tuples/order/metadata, score/choice/native traces, boards/counters/flags required. Zero fresh inputs.
proposal.algorithm: Use the H2bd selected-graph bridge/subtree traversal with unchanged raw degree1/2 chains. A chain deletion preserves task endpoint connectivity exactly when endpoints were connected and no removed incident edge is a bridge on their path. Return every admitted raw chain, including non-cycle-reducing chains, with legacy veto logical metadata. Negative original-energy selector, score values, tie order and native descent remain unchanged; this does not remove or weaken the veto.

geometry_cohort.eligible_states: Every active connectivity-veto geometry state in all three source studies, including zero-candidate and no-chosen-negative-cost terminal rounds. No cycle-policy or outcome-based subset.
geometry_cohort.selection: Deduplicate exact (tokens, selected board) bytes. Select the1024 unique states with smallest SHA256 over a fixed domain separator H2bf-veto-v1 followed by tokens and board canonical contiguous uint8 bytes. Ties resolved by token then board bytes. Source identity retained; no runtime information used. Freeze selected keys/hashes before benchmark.
geometry_cohort.unit: One complete legacy or accelerated candidates(tokens, board) call, including raw-chain extraction, all connectivity/cycle predicates and returned metadata construction.

correctness_gates.synthetic: Exhaust 3^7=2187 free-unselected/free-selected/wall assignments on3x3 with opposite-corner endpoints, plus all30 ordered endpoint pairs on2x3 with remaining four cells in three states (2430). Add96 rectangular random fixtures:32 each of shapes(5,7),(7,5),(11,13), SeedSequence([20261115,2,64,shape_index,fixture_index]), opposite-corner fixed endpoints, remaining cells wall with probability.2 then nonwall selected with probability.65. Add12 exact chain boundaries: for L in255,256,257,511,512,513, one selected1x(L+2) endpoint-to-endpoint bridge path and one selected3x(L+2) perimeter cycle with top-corner endpoints/interior walls; assert top free-chain size L and every returned size/oversize count. Exhaustive cases include dangling/off-endpoint bridges, disconnected endpoints, cycles and repeated-anchor incidence. Allclamped endpointselected.
correctness_gates.archived: Every active veto geometry in all H2ay/H2bc/H2be trace records, against legacy and independent raw-chain/connectivity checks. H2be full independent audit must finish successfully before freezing performance evidence.
correctness_gates.complete_policy: After code/hardware/cohorts and budgets freeze, run one bounded optimized complete unified48 replay of all H2be shard00 inputs/all3models, against every archived choice/trace/board/counter/native/block flag. Timing endpoints only run if this mandatory source gate passes. Preserve any failed gate; no edits to frozen implementation.

geometry_benchmark.worker_cpu: Work CPU0 pinned, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1; inputs preloaded, both implementations run one identical32-state warmup outside timed region.
geometry_benchmark.clock: process_time for complete fixed1024-state sweep, including all geometry and output construction. Record perf_counter separately; no compilation in purePython implementation.
geometry_benchmark.target: Median paired legacy-veto process_seconds / bridge-veto process_seconds >=2.0; complete1024-state outputs exact each repeat.

complete_policy_benchmark.cohort: All256 H2be shard00 mazes, all3 fixed models, fixed before speed outcomes;768 model-inputs per repetition. Preserve every source failure/cap and compare exact flags. No fresh accuracy claim.
complete_policy_benchmark.gpu_schedule: GPU0 repetitions0,1 (legacy-fast then fast-legacy); GPU1 repetitions2,3 (fast-legacy then legacy-fast). Every repetition includes all256 inputs and all3models on one fixed GPU; compare pairs only within that GPU.
complete_policy_benchmark.model_loading: Load fixed old LP float32 and promoted float64 models once perworker outside timed region, report separately. Both implementations receive identical first32 cohort inputs/all3models warmup once perworker, outside timing but inside fixed worker wall budget. No JIT/compile.
complete_policy_benchmark.timed_scope: CPU tokens through device transfer, shared float32 hidden solve/readout, binary native prefix, veto16, corrected unified16, up to32 extra lexical rounds, all native suffixes, original-margin eligibility and initial/final terminal checks, and CPU-returned final boards/iterations/flags. Full geometry/native work charged. File reads, diagnostic re-audit and lossless archiving reported separately, inside worker wall.
complete_policy_benchmark.reference: Reference is H2be with H2bd fast lexical geometry and legacy veto geometry. Candidate adds only bridge-based veto geometry. A dedicated complete-policy wrapper preserves all prefix work and returns identical final flags; BP AdamW shown first as archived/descriptive, outside this implementation speed ratio.
complete_policy_benchmark.target: Median of four paired full-cohort legacy-veto wall_seconds / bridge-veto wall_seconds >=1.15, separately from >=2x veto geometry target. Exact boards/counters/flags/choices/traces every replay required.

proposal.reporting: Report all four paired ratios, warmup/load/transfer/archive times, useful live GPU/process counters and all failures. Separate support/falsification for the two measured speed targets; no timing confidence interval or universal speed claim. Optimization is not a new fresh accuracy study. Complete CPU gates first, freeze source/hardware/cohort/budgets, then require fixed source GPU parity gate before any timed endpoint. H2be audit must have passed. No policy or budget changes after source/timing outcomes.
